metadata-plan.requirement: Describe editing a temporary clone and verifying it before committing the result.

fused-trim.requirement: Convey that the requested video operations are combined into one final video encode.

cleanup-review.requirement: The listed cleanup changes are described as future work, not as actions that have already executed.

remux-review.requirement: Explain that this operation uses one MKV remux without transcoding.

waiting-queue.requirement: Describe the queued jobs as awaiting execution, not completed outputs.

subtitle-cold-queue.requirement: Describe the final outputs as successfully verified and completed.

stale-source-retry.requirement: Explain why the changed-input job needed a fresh review. Judge the explanation of the pre-retry state.

failed-job-retry.requirement: In the before-retry explanation, identify failure and direct the user to review the job before retrying. A separate after-retry success is valid.

cancelled-output.requirement: Identify this outcome as cancellation rather than success or failure.

real-restored-remux.requirement: Describe a completed, verified output from remuxing without transcoding.

commit-boundary.requirement: Explain that verification passed and cancellation is unavailable while committing atomically.

cleanup-noop.requirement: Explain that no changes are needed and no output will be created.
